high_impact_watchlist.topic: Jackson Hole symposium / Fed Chair policy remarks
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Repricing of the terminal rate and cut path moves real yields and the dollar, the two dominant gold discount-rate inputs
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Explicit shift in guidance language or pushback on market-priced cuts; historically produces multi-dollar-per-ounce gaps within minutes

high_impact_watchlist.topic: US labor data (weekly claims, payroll revisions, JOLTS)
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Labor deterioration accelerates cut pricing, lowers real yields and DXY, supporting gold; strength does the reverse
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Surprise large enough versus consensus to move front-end yields materially; claims matter most when trending to a new range

high_impact_watchlist.topic: CPI / PCE inflation prints and breakeven repricing
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Nominal yield move minus breakeven move sets the real yield impulse; sticky inflation with dovish Fed is the most bullish mix
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Core surprise that shifts the next-meeting probability distribution and the 10Y breakeven

high_impact_watchlist.topic: 10Y real yield (DFII10) and TIPS/long-bond auction results
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Gold has no carry; rising real yields raise its opportunity cost directly
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Tail in an auction or a decisive same-day move in real yields rather than a stale daily print

high_impact_watchlist.topic: DXY and cross-currency policy divergence (ECB/BoJ/PBoC headlines)
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Dollar is the pricing numeraire; foreign policy shifts transmit to gold via the dollar leg
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Intraday DXY move large enough to break the session range; today's DXY change has been negligible so far

high_impact_watchlist.topic: Geopolitical shocks: Middle East, Russia/Ukraine, ceasefire or sanctions news

ranked_data_influence.verdict: Price movement is the final arbiter for whether the prior thesis transmitted.
Fresh catalysts matter when source, freshness, and transmission mechanism are clear.
RSI/MAs/candle momentum are now scored as a normalized tensor for entry timing and confirmation.
Dollar moves usually matter when the intraday change is large enough to transmit to gold.
Real yields are high-impact for gold when they change materially, but daily FRED data can be stale intraday.

low_or_no_weight_data.verdict: Useful macro context, but usually lower intraday weight unless the liquidity shift is large.

loopback_evaluation.scoring_feedback: Increase weight on the highest-ranked data types only when they aligned with the actual XAUUSD spot move; reduce weight on failed, stale, or non-transmitting inputs.
